experimentContext: Repeat the same basket after the local date boundary to measure short-term quote and offer visibility without placing an order.
tipPolicy: Set optional pickup tips to $0 before recording a final checkout total.
comparisonStatus: About 2.5 hours after the first capture, both channel totals and the $0.69 Uber Eats advantage were unchanged. The quotes were captured within 121 seconds and immediately rechecked.
limitations: This crossed the local date boundary but is still a same-night repeat; it does not satisfy the nonconsecutive multi-day requirement.
The direct cart restored stale state after it had appeared empty. The duplicate item was removed and the one-item subtotal was verified before either quote was accepted.
The timer started after both baskets were assembled. The 310 seconds measure quote handling and recheck, not end-to-end restaurant capture, so the manual-capture gate remains unproven.
The direct checkout was anonymous and Uber Eats was signed in because those were the user's normal available paths; account context is recorded per observation.
Uber Eats displayed one available promotion but no discount line. Its conditions were not verified, so no offer claim is made.
Both temporary carts were cleared after the recheck and no order was placed.
